actualEntryInspections.source: Digital Daijisen and Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual おんちゅう sections, not the page's headline reading オナカ or separate おなか/おちゅう sections.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Suffix follows organizational addressee names, such as offices, companies and groups, not individuals. Both inspected definitions corroborate the correspondence function.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The page includes different readings and identities. Seisenban's hedged historical 音読 note is not promoted to an etymological claim. The card explains current component readings from KANJIDIC2 and uses the existing native-first mixed-reading grouping.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual address-writing bullets, including organizational names and duplicated address honorifics.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Guidance rejects the duplicated pattern organizational 課御中 followed by an individual name with 様. Supports choosing organization or named individual rather than stacking honorifics for the addressee.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The original navi/mame_envelope.html URL redirected to the inspected enjoy/culture/howto path. No claim of a complete modern business-correspondence manual.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual cloud-amount definitions and forecast-use qualifications.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Observed 快晴 has cloud amount one or less; observed 晴れ has two through eight, and forecast 晴れ includes 快晴. Supports little or no cloud rather than a literally cloudless requirement.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The card does not teach every numerical operational threshold. Technical observation categories and everyday overlapping English descriptions are not treated as identical.

actualEntryInspections.source: Digital Daijisen and Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual ordinary noun/suru definitions and law/rule examples.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Revision addresses unsuitable or insufficient points, especially rules and laws. Does not require every observer to agree that a particular amendment improves matters.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Related-word lists are not proofs of unrestricted substitutability. The specialized legal drafting note is outside the practical card's scope.

actualEntryInspections.source: Digital Daijisen and Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.headword: かいすうけん, 回数券
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual ticket-set definitions, including transport, admission and dining uses.
actualEntryInspections.observation: A set covers multiple uses, usually or often with some discount. Supports qualified discount wording and examples beyond rail transport.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Does not establish current availability at any named operator, a universal ticket quantity or an unlimited period pass.

actualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual ordinary rebuilding/remaking noun definition, before the separate magazine history.
actualEntryInspections.observation: The ordinary definition concerns remaking or reconstructing. Only that definition is supporting evidence; the long magazine sections are a different identity.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The fetched Digital Daijisen section describes the magazine, not the ordinary word. It is not claimed as ordinary-word verification. Computing modding and reshuffle senses are supported by the pinned complete JMdict family.
